title: night-b-roller-jitter
summary: Jittered water mesh (to break up circular moire), rollers whose Height setting now means what it says, a 2 m / 25 m roller preset, and the Home Valley rollers sea restored on the new Gorge terrain. Builds on the published night-a-near-water.
problem: The regular rings-and-spokes water mesh can print circles and beat against the waves into circular moire. A roller set to 3 m behaved like a 4 to 5 ft wave.
implemented: Water mesh: every other ring is shifted half a spoke and each vertex is nudged by a fixed random fraction of its cell (up to 0.3 of a cell). `?jitter=0` gives the old regular grid for comparison; `?jitter=0.6` is the default.

Rollers: the Height setting is now the height of the bigger rollers (average of the tallest third, crest to trough); the typical roller is about three quarters of it. The wave the old 3 m setting made is now made by 2 m, so a 2 m, 25 m roller looks as before. Old saved seas with rollers come out about 1.5 times taller than they did.
Roller group default is 2 m high, 25 m long. The roller preset is "Rollers, 25 m long, 2 m high" (replaces "Small rollers").
Home Valley rollers sea is offered again at Home Valley (it was lost when the start moved to the new Gorge terrain).
Opt-in experiment: `?sector=1` fans the water mesh over the camera's view only. Not measured; off by default.
review: Look for circular or starburst patterns in the water near the boat while moving, with `?jitter=0` and without.
Sea tab, add a group, Rollers: check that 2 m / 25 m looks like the roller you liked.
known: A still frame shows no difference; whether the circular moire is gone needs your eyes in motion. Against an Ultra-density mesh, the jittered mesh differs by about 14 percent more in grey levels than the regular one (a different kind of error, not a lower quality).
Performance not measured on a quiet machine.

git.subject: feat: jittered water mesh (breaks circular moire), rollers' Height means the bigger rollers (2 m x 25 m = the old 3 m wave), roller preset, Home Valley rollers sea restored; opt-in view sector
